correctness.rationale: Gill–Linusson Theorem 3 and Torres Theorem 3.1 give precisely nonnegative entries, row/column at most one, and total k. Uniform center is strictly feasible, so intrinsic dimension is \(mn-1\). The uniqueness and S_m×S_n invariance of John ellipsoid reduce the global shape operator to the three inequivalent irreducible Frobenius-orthogonal summands of dimensions \(m-1\), \(n-1\), \((m-1)(n-1)\). The projected coordinate-normal squared norms equal A,B,D, and the row and column normals give the exact independent shape caps U,V. Consequently containment is equivalent to the stated three affine scalar inequalities. The log-volume objective is strictly concave with multiplicities exactly mn times A,B,D; the full KKT equations give \(\alpha=\min(q,U)\), \(\beta=\min(q,V)\), and the strictly increasing budget equation, proving unique global optimum. Explicit \(q_0,q_1\) and cap-crossing algebra establish each boundary and contact pattern. The standalone exact-rational verifier passed 8,318 parameter triples, separately assembled and checked 3,703 affine facet normals and their support inequalities, and tested 2,851 constructed contact points against all defining halfspaces. Finite tests are not used as infinite proofs.

General John-ellipsoid theorems give existence and uniqueness; their statements do not contain the closed rational three-eigenspace classification. An ambient ellipsoid does not in general restrict to a face’s John ellipsoid.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The earlier equal-side-length case has coincident row and column symmetry and two eigenvalue blocks; it cannot imply a non-isometric rectangular optimizer with three independent isotypic blocks and an intermediate row-only contact phase. Generic optimization machinery can in principle derive the answer only after new explicit spectral/facet calculations and KKT resolution. A broader formula not found remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: A complete, exact intrinsic-Euclidean maximum-volume inscribed ellipsoid is determined for the natural two-size family of fixed k partial assignments, including center, three multiplicity-resolved eigenvalues, full volume, all facet contacts, explicit tangency points and rational thresholds. The unequal-side row-only regime is genuinely absent from equal-side-length symmetry. The exact \((m,n,k)=(4,5,3)\) contact separation and all-cap \((m,n,k)=(7,8,6)\) demonstrate the necessity of distinguishing row and column constraints. This is a nontrivial structural geometric invariant and supports direct evaluation without vertex enumeration; its value does not rely on generic computational reproducibility alone.
